desc:
◈ Explore the islands and uncover all the secrets they have to offer.
◈ Earn over 170 badges, with more coming soon!

◈ Deliver crates, catch fireflies, explore, sail rafts, and more.
◈ Unlock fireworks that you can launch anywhere (find them around the map and create your own firework shows!

◈ Collect crystals across the map and save up for a fishing rod.
◈ Catch fish and other items using fishring rods and crab cages.

Be sure to join my group for a special in-game tag!
